hazard: sightings.csv mixes DD/MM/YYYY and ISO dates and has a quoted comma in a name; amateur.json uses different field names with mixed date formats; results must span both sources, ordered by day with ties in listing order (csv before amateur)
prompt: In the comet-sightings app, add an exported function sightingsInMonth(year, month) to src/sightings.mjs (month is 1-12).
